body: @DrMatthiasArnold Thanks for reporting this issue! I was able to confirm this [here](https://issues.streamlit.app/?issue=gh-7831). But I'm not sure yet why this is happening. We might soon release a better way to do data streaming via partial reruns. This will hopefully resolve this issue here as well.
